QuestInfo.name: Building a Time Machine 3: Miner in a Gas Mask
QuestInfo.0: #b#p9250126##k is looking for Fossil Minerals, which are needed to build the Time Machine.
QuestInfo.1: Use the OS4 Shuttle located in the OSSS Secret Base to travel to the #b#m502010300##k.\r\n\r\nDestroy the Fossil Mineral mounds located throughout the mine and bring back 10 Fossil Minerals #b#i04032709:##k.
QuestInfo.2: You brought back the Fossil Minerals required for the Time Machine.

0.0: We need Fossil Minerals for the Time machine. Obtain them by breaking Fossil Mineral Mounds near the Mine.
0.1: Use the OS4 Shuttle in the Hangar to get there. When you arrive at the Mine, you'll be wearing the OS3D Mining Suit.
0.2: Since the mine is filled with toxic gas, you cannot take off the suit! It's equipped with weapons, so if aliens show up, fight them!

yes.0: And worry not. There is a zero percent chance of the mine collapsing. I hope...
I wonder if the Fossil Minerals allow you to manipulate time or something...

item.0: I told you! Ten Fossil Minerals! Ten!
